subject: Emotions
title: Moral Outrage Addiction
description: A fast breakdown of Moral Outrage Addiction for builders.

hook.text: Social media feeds serve moral outrage like a drug. Each shocking post triggers disgust and a dopamine hit.

buildup.text: Moral disgust activates reward circuits. Feeling outraged makes you feel righteous, which feels good.

discovery.text: William Brady found that each moral-emotional word in a tweet increases retweets by 20%.

twist.text: Chronic outrage erodes empathy. The disgust fires so often that real suffering stops registering.

climax.text: Platforms optimize for engagement, not accuracy. Manufactured disgust drives more clicks than truth.

punchline.text: Outrage feels productive but mostly just feels good.

quiz.question: How much do moral-emotional words increase retweets?
